Repeatable workflows for coding agents

Use project-level agent instructions to standardize prompts, model choices, and output paths around CAPI. CAPI routes model requests; the agent runs the workflow.

Agent workflows

Make workflow choices reviewable

Keep model IDs, prompt templates, and output conventions in your repository so the team can review and reuse them.

01

Consistent output

Keep the prompt template, model ID, and output conventions together in your agent workflow.

02

Reviewable by default

Review prompt and model changes before your coding agent uses them.

03

Spend stays visible

CAPI applies configured model rates and workspace or key budgets to requests.

04

Composable

Agent instructions can combine CAPI requests with your own download and file-placement steps.

Getting started

Three steps to a repeatable workflow

  1. 1

    Add project instructions

    Keep your agent workflow files with the repository so teammates can review and reuse them.

  2. 2

    Configure CAPI

    Use the documented API base URL and a scoped key, then select a model enabled for your workspace.

  3. 3

    Run and review

    Invoke the workflow in your coding agent, then review the result and workspace usage.

Examples

Workflow patterns

These are examples for your own coding-agent instructions, not hosted or installable CAPI skills.

WorkflowAreaDescription
brand-imageryimage · brandProduct and marketing visuals in your house style — pinned model, aspect ratio, and prompt scaffold.
release-videovideo · releaseShort teaser clips from a changelog, with a consistent shot list and caption tone.
doc-diagramsimage · docsDiagram-style images that match the documentation's palette and stroke weight.
social-cropsimage · socialOne master asset, cropped and re-composed for each channel's aspect ratio.

Start with the CAPI API guides, then add the prompt and file-handling steps your team needs to its coding-agent workflow.
